item.title: Projects
item.description:
Projects

Lisp Interpreter

C

A Lisp interpreter built from scratch with an interactive REPL, S-expression parsing, environment bindings, conditionals, arithmetic, and classic list primitives.

BanterMart

React, Vite, Supabase, Gemini, World ID, MiniKit

An AI-negotiated marketplace where verified buyers and sellers delegate bargaining to agents, approve deals themselves, and settle payments in USDC.

UofTWebring

Next.js, Vercel, Supabase, PostgreSQL

Building a unified space for UofT students to gather and showcase their web portfolios.

Collaborative Shopping Cart

React, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker

item.title: Reflecting on my time at RBC Amplify
item.description:
Through a series of miraculous strokes of luck, from being rejected to a consolation acceptance few weeks later, I ended up interning at RBC in the Amplify program this summer.

To start, I am incredibly grateful for what this summer has turned out to be. The work I did, the knowledge I learned, the mistakes I made, the people I met and the experiences I have encountered were so formative for me as not just an engineer but as a human being. In all honesty, RBC Amplify really is not your typical internship.

item.title: Hello World!
item.description:
This is the beginning… hopefully… Edit: nah screw that we’ll make it work

I have always wanted to write, but never really put any effort towards doing so. This will be my first real attempt at blogging and documenting what I am up to, whether that is tech related or just random snippets of my life.

I have always looked up to people who write, formally or informally, and I have grew tremendously from reading the things other people have written. Particularly, Max Bernstein, Michal Pitr, Patrick Collison and so many more people. To those who tune into the subsequent blogs, I hope they can help provide even the slightest insight into something interesting you didn’t know about and make you a fuller person.
